findings.entity: Dancer's arm tattoo and its mirror reflection
findings.description: At 00:00 the tattoo is on the dancer's right arm — the arm extended out to her side (viewer-right of her body) — while her hanging left arm appears clean. Her mirror reflection shows the tattoo on the opposite arm: the hanging arm on the viewer-left side of the reflection, while the reflection of the extended arm is clean. In a true mirror the tattoo's reflection must appear on the same image side as the real tattoo. From 00:02 onward the tattoo appears on the left arm in both the dancer and the reflection, and the right-arm marking seen at 00:00 is no longer visible on the subject, making the 00:00 right-arm tattoo and its mismatched reflection an unexplained continuity error.
